title: 5 Tips for Better Color Pickers
summary: This reel explores five essential features for a high-performance color picker in UI design tools. It covers human-readable color formats, memory, real-time contrast checking, alpha previews, and automated palette generation.

transcript.text: Pick a color. Your whole UI answers.
Hex is for machines. OKLCH reads like a human. Lightness, Chroma, Hue. Change one number, get a predictable shade.
A picker without memory wastes your day. Recent swatches, saved palettes. Your last five picks. One tap away.
Check contrast at pick time, not in review. A live ratio badge flips red to green. Bad pairs die before they ship.
Transparency lies on white. A checkerboard tells the truth. Preview alpha on light and dark before you commit.
One pick builds the system. Generate tints and shades from a single hue. 10 tokens, 1 decision.
Follow for more design tooling. Save this for your next design system.
